decisions.title: Stateless JWT Auth with HMAC-SHA256 & Redis Revocation List
decisions.decision: Adopt stateless signed JWT access tokens with 15-minute expiration coupled with Redis bloom filter for immediate revocation.
decisions.rationale: Enables horizontal scaling of backend pods while supporting instant security invalidation.

decisions.title: Hierarchical Bin Addressing Scheme (Hub:Zone:Aisle:Shelf:Bin)
decisions.decision: Standardize all warehouse coordinate storage on a canonical 5-tier hierarchical string token.
decisions.rationale: Simplifies prefix-based range queries and physical warehouse forklift routing.

decisions.title: Polyglot Schema: Relational SKU Core with JSONB Attribute Bag
decisions.decision: Store fixed SKU dimensions in standard MySQL columns and dynamic certification tags in indexed JSON columns.
decisions.rationale: Accommodates diverse supplier specs without requiring DDL alterations for new cargo types.

decisions.title: Optimistic Concurrency Control with Versioned Stock Pools
decisions.decision: Implement row-level versioning on stock pool records; reject reservations on version mismatch with exponential backoff.
decisions.rationale: Prevents catastrophic overselling during flash-order peaks while avoiding deadlock-prone SELECT FOR UPDATE.

decisions.title: Asynchronous EDI/X12 and JSON Ingestion via Kafka/RabbitMQ
decisions.decision: Decouple supplier order submission from backend processing using an ingestion queue.
decisions.rationale: Shields core database from vendor retry storms during EDI batch uploads.

decisions.title: Saga Pattern for Multi-Warehouse Split Order Orchestration
decisions.decision: Coordinate split order fulfillment using an orchestrated Saga coordinator with compensating rollbacks.
decisions.rationale: Guarantees eventual consistency across regional hub databases without distributed 2PC transactions.

decisions.title: Time-Series Telemetry Ingestion via Partitioned MySQL Tables
decisions.decision: Partition IoT waypoint records by month and vehicle_id hash.
decisions.rationale: Maintains high write throughput and enables rolling archival of historical tracking data.

decisions.title: Hybrid Dijkstra/Genetic Algorithm for Dynamic Rerouting
decisions.decision: Use pre-computed highway graphs with local genetic algorithm optimizations for urban last-mile delivery.
decisions.rationale: Satisfies the sub-500ms route calculation requirement for dispatchers.

decisions.title: Two-Tier Priority Pre-emption Protocol for Medical Disasters
decisions.decision: Hospital emergency requests automatically pre-empt commercial orders and reserve stock at the closest reachable hub.
decisions.rationale: Ensures FEMA/WHO compliance for disaster relief response.

decisions.title: Server-Sent Events (SSE) for Ops Web UI with SMS Twilio Fallback
decisions.decision: Stream operational alerts over SSE; trigger SMS webhook when alert severity is CRITICAL and unacknowledged within 60s.
decisions.rationale: Minimizes connection overhead while guaranteeing delivery to on-call warehouse managers.

decisions.title: Read-Replicated Analytics Views with Materialized 15-Minute Rollups
decisions.decision: Route analytical queries to read-replicas querying materialized summary tables.
decisions.rationale: Protects OLTP write performance on core order/inventory tables.

decisions.title: SHA-256 Merkle Audit Log for Chain-of-Custody Signoffs
decisions.decision: Every custody transfer event is hashed with the previous event hash, forming an append-only chain.
decisions.rationale: Provides non-repudiation and meets regulatory inspection mandates.
